agency: Wisconsin Department of Transportation, Division of Highways
summary: The agency directed the commenter to page 19 for a fuller response and stated that while local streets can handle current traffic, they will not be able to efficiently or safely handle the increased airport-oriented traffic expected in the future.
text:
Please see page 19 for a response.
The local streets are capable of handling present day traffic but will not be able to handle the increased airport oriented traffic efficiently or safely.
